events.what_it_is: A free immersive cat-themed bodega pop-up celebrating NYC shop cats, with photo moments, games and bodega-inspired merchandise prizes.
events.what_is_free: Admission is free. Visitors can take home free TEMPTATIONS treats and can play for exclusive Cat Bodega merchandise.
events.caveats: The official brand source describes this as a free pop-up visitors can stop by; no advance RSVP requirement is published. Treats and merchandise/prizes are promotional and may be limited by supply or game availability.
events.practical_notes: Open Sept. 17–19, 12–6 PM each day at 213 Bowery. No purchase or advance RSVP requirement is stated by the official source.

events.event_name: Bobbi Brown — The Prime Times Newsstand
events.address: Chelsea Triangle, 9th Avenue between 14th and 15th Street, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day Bobbi Brown newsstand experience for the Vitamin Enriched Face Base+, with product sampling, refreshments, scratch-off giveaways and a mirrored photo moment.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary product sample, grapefruit Spindrift, mini croissant and scratch-off giveaway while supplies last; select winners receive a full-size product. The first 100 guests are advertised to receive a deluxe-size sample.
events.caveats: The host-published event listing shows free $0 registration and identifies BOBBI BROWN Cosmetics as host. Samples, refreshments and prizes are explicitly while supplies last. This is a free RSVP/registration path, not an approval-required application.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 17, 12–6 PM at Chelsea Triangle, 9th Avenue between 14th and 15th Streets. Photo/video content will be captured during the event for brand social/digital use.

events.event_name: CookUnity — The Most Legendary Lunch Break
events.address: Bari Bodega, 873 Broadway; Madison Square Deli & Convenience, 266 W 23rd St; New York Pizza and Cafe, 369 Madison Ave; Sam's Deli, 275 W 4th St; Slice N' Spice Deli & Grill, 451 3rd Ave, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: A three-hour CookUnity takeover of five Manhattan bodegas with eight chefs serving complimentary signature dishes, hot samples, cold meals to go and scratch-off prizes.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary chef-made meals and hot samples while supplies last, plus a bodega-style scratch-off for chances to win CookUnity meals and dining experiences.
events.caveats: Public walk-in giveaway; no RSVP requirement is published in the corroborating current listings. Food is while supplies last and lines are expected, so arrival does not guarantee a meal after inventory is exhausted.
events.practical_notes: Thursday Sept. 17 only, 11:30 AM–2:30 PM. Five Manhattan locations: Flatiron, Chelsea, Midtown, West Village and Murray Hill. Arrive early because quantities are limited.
